item.title: JPlag vs Dolos vs compare50: Self-Hosted Code Plagiarism Detection Guide 2026
item.description: Academic integrity in programming courses is increasingly challenged by online code sharing, copilot suggestions, and peer collaboration that crosses into copying. Self-hosted code plagiarism detection tools help educators identify structural similarities in student submissions without sending source code to third-party services.
